description: Details of contractual arrangement with a certified contractor for ongoing maintenance of renewable/low-carbon energy equipment part pursuant to condition 20 (Part B only) of  planning permission 181380FUL dated 22.12.2021 for: 'Demolition of existing structures and residential-led, mixed use redevelopment to provide four buildings ranging in height from 15 to 23 storeys comprising residential (575 units), 2,100 sq m of B1(a) office floorspace, 449 sq m of flexible commercial floorspace (Use Classes A1, A2, A3, B1a and D1), erection of a boundary wall along the railway line, along with landscaping, play and amenity space, cycle parking, servicing bays, plant and refuse areas, and new access arrangements.'
